issues.description: Method name mismatch for the arbitrary-n QFT forward implementation. The problem statement (Exercise 7) and the solution implement/expect a method named qft_circuit_n_qubits(...). In the template the forward method is declared as _qft_circuit_n_qubits(...), i.e. it has a leading underscore. This naming mismatch will confuse students about which method to implement and will likely make automated tests (and the provided solution) fail to locate the student's implementation.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename the forward QFT method in the template from _qft_circuit_n_qubits to qft_circuit_n_qubits (remove the leading underscore) so that the template, the problem statement (tests), and the solution all use the same method name. Alternatively, if the underscore was intentional, update the problem statement/tests and the solution to reference the underscored method name consistently.
